summary: The Division of Highways acknowledged the School Board's interest in the undeveloped parcels along Parnell Avenue and stated that this matter would be investigated.
text: The City of Milwaukee School Board has expressed interest in the undeveloped parcels along Parnell Avenue as compensation for the land taken from Hamlin-Garland School. This will be investigated by the Division of Highways.
